parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'adenosine A2a receptor' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY compound_chembl_id;
